Hetzner.claim_summary: 100% green electricity via Guarantees of Origin certificates from naturenergie (2023-2025) and Vattenfall EPD Hydro (2025-2026). Hydropower since 2008 (Germany) / 2018 (Finland). EMAS-audited German locations.
caveats: Acknowledges 'not yet completely climate neutral'

HZ-EU.claim_summary: ASN label, presumed Hetzner EU IP block. Inherits Hetzner classification for EU datacenters.
caveats: Not a separate entity, inferred from naming

Akamai (Linode).tier_label: VPPAs + RECs, emissions-first procurement, 95% colocation aligned
Akamai (Linode).claim_summary: Targets 100% renewable for Akamai Connected Cloud. December 2024: ~95% of network deployments are in colocation facilities licensed/leased from partners with strong renewable alignment. 11.8% increase in renewable power used 2024 over 2023. Uses Locational Marginal Emissions (LMEs) tracking via REsurety (emissions-first approach). VPPA 2.0s through Net Zero Consortium for Buyers. Direct akamai.com PDF blocked at edge but sustainability microsite on Linode hosting is accessible.

named_projects: Prairie Solar IL (44.8MW share, ~100,177 MWh/yr, online Q1 2026, prevents ~77,000 tCO2e/yr)
specifics.procurement_type: VPPA 2.0 through Net Zero Consortium for Buyers + REC + LME tracking
specifics.methodology_tracking: Locational Marginal Emissions (LMEs) via REsurety partnership

caveats: Headline % across full network not published as single number
100% commitment is target; 95% colocation aligned is the closest verified coverage figure (Dec 2024)
Procurement is genuinely sophisticated (LME tracking is rare) but headline % opaque

OVH.claim_summary: 100% Renewable Energy Factor (REF) across all 9 owned datacenters as of FY2025. INDEPENDENTLY AUDITED by APAVE (engineering risk management firm) to ISO/IEC 30134-3 standard for REF. Audit report dated 30 September 2025. Group-level PUE 1.24, WUE 0.34 L/kWh. Water cooling proprietary since 2003. 27 DCs are rehabilitated buildings.
caveats: MAJOR UPGRADE from initial Tier 5 to Tier 3 after fetching FY25 KPIs PDF
REF mechanism (PPA vs RECs) not specified in this PDF but is independently audited to ISO 30134-3 standard
Procurement specifics likely in separate sustainability report; would need to fetch that for Tier 1-2 evidence
Audit scope: OVHcloud-owned data centers only
